```plato

    // True when the shape lies within `radius` of the query point (inclusive).
    // Compares squared distances, so no square root is taken.
    WithinDistance(self: INearestPoint2D, point: Point2D, radius: Number): Boolean
        => self.DistanceToSquared(point) <= radius * radius;
```
